title: METATOOL BENCHMARK FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: DECIDING WHETHER TO USE TOOLS AND WHICH TO USE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparities by measuring the Correct Selection Rate (CSR) of LLMs when selecting tools for queries related to specific professions (e.g., software engineers, finance staff, house managers, artists and designers).

Comparing the tool selection accuracy (Correct Selection Rate) of LLMs across different age-related demographic user groups, specifically highlighting performance imbalances between queries aimed at 'elders' versus 'students'.
